title_en: Apartment - For Sale - Univers City, Tirana
description_en: The apartment is located on the seventh residential floor of a newly completed building with an elevator, part of the Univers City complex. It has a total area of ​​86.85 meters and a net area of ​​73.77 meters. Organized in: A distribution corridor. Living room together with the kitchen. Two bedrooms, one of which (the master bedroom) has access to the balcony. A toilet. A balcony. The property has a business contract and is in the mortgage process. For more information, or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact us!
